pages.title: Who Lost Their Head?
pages.text: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: both Beheaded Knight and Resurrected Knight.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: This native paired challenge has two separate defeat conditions. It does not replace Bone Stalker or Overgrown Colossus and does not add a mandatory campaign eye.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The native challenge requires both knights, not either one; forest campaign gatekeepers are different entities.
